frame_transform: design frame has USB at +X; normalised by mirroring X (x' = 80 - x). Coordinates below are design frame unless marked normalised.

through_openings.method: free space minus (ALL + both apertures): cavity is a separate component; without filling, cavity joins outside

observations: Capacitor (centre (19.5, 20), r 5) is only 0.16 mm from the Pico PCB end edge (X 24.66) in plan; no interference (0 mm3) so L3.1.4.1 passes, but it is physically tight. Visible in ghost_front.png between the yellow cylinder and the blue/purple Pico stack.

Several margins are 0.10 mm: lid lip bottom Z 23.10 vs V-KO-TOP top 23.0; floor top Z -5.70 vs V-KO-BOT bottom -5.60; base inner wall X/Y -1.10 vs V-HOLE-KO columns at -1.00. All pass but have no slack.

End-wall slab aperture enumeration also returns two 17-18 mm3 regions per end wall at the corners ([81.6..83.5, -3.5..-1.6, 19.1..27.6] etc.): these are the blind M3 boss pilot + lid hole pockets, i.e. screw holes, not through-paths into the cavity (confirmed by connectivity).
